def test_database_connection():
    conn = sqlite3.connect('db.sqlite3')
    cursor = conn.cursor()
    cursor.execute('SELECT sqlite_version();')
    version = cursor.fetchone()
    conn.close()
    assert version is not None, "Database connection failed!"

test_database_connection()
